purpose: Developer calibration only; agent-authored labels from titles, ingredients and preparation. Not human-reviewed, not held-out evidence.
definition: Near means a variation of the same dish preparation, not nutritional interchangeability or safety equivalence. Different cooking forms remain distinct.
